```{python}
import os

for name in ("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO", "QUARTO_PROJECT_ROOT", "QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH", "QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE"):
    print(name, "=", os.environ.get(name))

info = os.environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
if info:
    import json
    raw = open(info).read()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    print("execute-info bytes:", len(raw))
    print("format keys:", sorted(data["format"].keys()))
    print("bytes per format bin:", {k: len(json.dumps(v)) for k, v in data["format"].items()})
    brand = data["format"]["render"].get("brand")
    print("brand modes:", None if brand is None else {k: (v is not None) for k, v in brand.items()})
```
